verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate DeepSeek releases model weights that people run locally. One cites a ~154 GB native-precision weight size for the Flash model, described as 'very accessible for people running large local models'; others call it open-source and contrast it with 'the hosted version'. The first-party docs cover only the hosted API, so self-hosting rests entirely on community statements. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting or weight-download documentation, licensing terms, deployment/inference-stack guidance, hands-on reports of a successful self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: native precision weights total ~154 GB, KV cache 10% as much as V3 - very accessible for people running large local models
At least don't use the hosted version unless you want your data to go to China.
